## [By business line]{.en}[按业务线]{.zh}

::: {.en}
::: {.placeholder}
- Table: shortcut · approval it shortens/avoids · conditions · catch · evidence (confirmed / to verify) · link
- WtE: partner with cap holder; coal site with grid connection; co-locate at treatment plant; biosolids-only plant (exempt waste); service-only role; state fast-track planning [to verify]
- Meters: Chinese ISO 17025 / OIML-CS lab report accepted by NMI; distributor with test lab; non-billing trial meters [to verify]
- Chemicals: chemicals already on AICIS inventory [to verify]; distributor already on supply panels

- 水表：国内ISO 17025/OIML认可实验室报告供NMI采信；与有检测实验室的代理商合作；非计费试点表【待核实】
